entries.test: Test 1: subprocess exit code is bounded 0 or 1 (never 2 = uncaught throw) when run against the sentinel test env
entries.change: Child now started through spawnRailedChild on the sentinel test env. Title and comment changed from 'against current .env' to 'against the sentinel test env'. Assertions unchanged (status not null, 0 or 1, never 2).
entries.reason: The test depended on the operator's real .env, network and DB: it spawned preflight with the parent environment, so the child reloaded real configuration. RESEARCH Pitfall 7, D-03.

entries.reason: D-03: no child env from the parent. ETH_WS_RPC_URL is a key the code never reads (src/chainRegistry.ts:211 reads ETH_WS_URL) and it is not a test/.env.test key, so spawnRailedChild refuses it. The old override was silently a no-op.

entries.title: HONEY-03: HoneypotChecker deployed on ETH > has bytecode at deployedAddress (not 0x)
entries.test: has bytecode at deployedAddress (not 0x)
entries.change: The one test moved to the fork project by operator ruling; both assertions are word for word. Integration file: JsonRpcProvider import and provider creation removed, because nothing left in the file used them. beforeAll, its ETH_RPC_URL guard, the address resolution and the second test are unchanged. Fork file: the URL comes from resolveForkRpcUrl, not ETH_RPC_URL, and an unset URL is an error rather than a skip, matching the other fork files. The address comes from buildChainRegistry().get('eth').honeypotChecker.deployedAddress, which applies the same precedence the old file wrote by hand (ETH_HONEYPOT_CHECKER_ADDRESS, then the template default), because test/unit/rails/forkShellOnly.test.ts forbids a fork test reading a key the rails replace.
entries.reason: A live mainnet check cannot pass in the integration project, which the rails keep off the real RPC: ETH_RPC_URL is the sentinel http://127.0.0.1:1, so the call was refused. Skip, delete and a canned-bytecode fake were all forbidden. See rails-discoveries.json#2 and ESC-RAILS-01. The per-file count is 2 to 1 and the fork file 0 to 1; the plan's must-be-equal rule holds on the total, by the operator's ruling.
